slide.takeaway: Only an eligible Item selection adds its selected lines to deck coverage, labeled as inherited; drift and outside-subset edits are reported separately.

item.label: Saved selection path
item.description: A selection names the Item's pin, each declared hop at its saved revision, a revision-unique evidence ID and a subset; the records resolver checks structure and the selected digest is verified at its own commit.

references.note: Structure is delegated to the records resolver; pin, selected-byte and containing health are reported separately.

criterion_links.rationale: The Item retains an inspectable selection; a System pin does not select all members or their code.
Results expose the Item, the declared path and the selected locations.

item.label: Eligibility at head
item.description: Only selections whose structure resolves, whose pins are all current and whose selected bytes are current at head contribute; others contribute nothing and stay visible in query inventory-selections.

references.note: Eligible selections become inherited references; the document is never modified.

criterion_links.rationale: Selected code counts through the inventory reference without a duplicate authored mapping.

item.label: Labeled inherited coverage
item.description: Inherited lines are Item-owned coverage assignments carrying the selection, path and evidence ID with no evidence file, so no evidence-file repair can name them; unselected lines earn nothing.

references.note: Inherited assignments are labeled and never reported as stale evidence records.

criterion_links.rationale: Unselected code earns no inherited coverage and overlapping selections count once.
Inherited coverage is labeled and records no approval; it does not conceal unexplained changes.

item.label: Separate selection health
item.description: An edit outside the subset keeps the selected bytes current but marks the containing evidence for semantic reassessment; an edit inside makes the selection stale and it stops contributing.

references.note: Selected-byte drift and outside-subset changes are distinct reasons; eligibility needs current pins and bytes.

criterion_links.rationale: Stale or unresolved paths remain visible rather than count as current coverage.
